articles.title: Letter: Support the Crosswalk
body: To the editor: I hope the council will listen to the people who turned out at the July meeting. To the editor: I have lived on Prospect Terrace for 8 years, and I want to say what a difference the Marsh Landing Pond Committee has made.
Please keep the crosswalk in the budget. Many of us on Prospect Terrace use it every week. Thank you for printing this letter, and for all the work the paper does to keep us informed.
